candidates.name: Benzoylaconine

classical_lead.processing: 炮 → 去皮臍 → 蜜水煮 (雷公炮炙論)
classical_lead.source: 神農本草經 · 傷寒論 · 雷公炮炙論

candidates.structure_note: no structure recorded; leave null rather than invent one (brief §11.3)

mechanism.target_class: voltage-gated Na⁺ channel, site 2 — partial block (monester, not diester)

novelty.basis: the *processed* monester is the form the classical protocol targets; modern granule products that skip 炮制 retain the diester

candidates.theory_justification: 辛·熱, 下品 (i.e. toxic by grade), entering 心 and 腎 — the two organs of circulation and deep structure. A 下品·辛·熱 drug with 心 tropism should be the most cardiotoxic class in the materia medica, and aconitine is. The theory correctly predicts both the toxicity *and* the organ, which is why the processing protocol matters: it is a toxicity-selectivity step.

development_path.step: LC-MS/MS quantification of the diester→monester→alkamine ladder across processing arms.
Zebrafish heart-rate and rat ECG dose-response for each of the three alkaloids.
Human plasma monitoring study on prescribed 附子 granule products vs classical decoction.

residual_risk: The therapeutic window is extremely narrow — this is a lead for *toxicity mitigation*, not a new therapy.
Classical 生用 use in 四逆湯 shows the processing is a choice, not a rule; a candidate claim must specify which form it means.
Purity of reference alkaloids is a supply-chain problem for any follow-up study.

flags: aconitine is a highly toxic cardiotoxin
no preparation method is given anywhere in this output — by design
the deliverable is a hazard/safety finding, not a dosing regimen

candidates.structure_note: no structure recorded; leave null rather than invent one (brief §11.3)

mechanism.target_class: candidate: Nrf2/ARE induction with mitochondrial membrane stabilisation
mechanism.pathway: hepatocyte antioxidant response; mitochondrial permeability transition inhibition

classical_lead.source: 本草綱目 · 本草備要

candidates.structure_note: no structure recorded; leave null rather than invent one (brief §11.3)

mechanism.target_class: candidate: ginsenoside — endothelial protection via PI3K/Akt and oestrogen-receptor adjacent signalling

novelty.basis: the notoginseng saponin fraction is distinct from ginseng's, and the standardisation problem (white vs red vs steamed) is unaddressed

classical_lead.source: 神農本草經 · 傷寒論 · 雷公炮炙論

candidates.structure_note: no structure recorded; leave null rather than invent one (brief §11.3)

mechanism.pathway: cortisol → cortisone inactivation in the distal nephron; MR occupancy

novelty.basis: the 11β-HSD2 liability is textbook; the discovery is that the corpus encodes it as a contraindication, not a mechanism

candidates.theory_justification: 甘 = 緩 and 補, classified 平, entering 脾/胃 (the transformation axis). candidates.name: Artemisinin

classical_lead.processing: cold extraction with water (冷浸) — the classical instruction
classical_lead.source: 本草綱目 · 肘後備急方

candidates.structure_note: canonical SMILES — resolve against PubChem PUG-REST by name at build time

mechanism.target_class: endoperoxide — heme-mediated radical activation; PfATP6 and multiple parasite targets
mechanism.pathway: parasite oxidative stress; artemisinin resistance via Kelch13

novelty.basis: the single most famous instance of the corpus producing a drug — included as the historical anchor, with near-zero novelty

candidates.theory_justification: 苦·寒, entering 肝/膽 — a liver-and-gallbladder tropism for a febrile disease that the tradition called 瘧. The endoperoxide is activated by haem iron, and haem catabolism happens in the liver and in the parasite's digestive vacuole. This is the case study that proves the whole thesis is possible; it is also the reason nobody should be impressed by novelty alone.

development_path.step: None needed — this is the anchor example.

residual_risk: Resistance (Kelch13) is now widespread; monotherapy is contraindicated.
The classical preparation (cold water extract) differs from the modern purified compound — the corpus's own instruction is a solubility insight.
